newsitem.title: USA: Fla. McIntosh power unit seen on line by weekend.
newsitem.headline: Fla. McIntosh power unit seen on line by weekend.

text.p: A 90 megawatt (MW) power unit, fueled by both natural gas and fuel oil, at the McIntosh generating station is expected to restart Friday night, said a spokeswoman for the City of Lakeland, Fla.
"The unit should restart sometime tomorrow and be back on-line this weekend," she said.
The unit has been shut since October for a turbine overhaul.
A 350 MW coal-fired unit and another gas and fuel oil-fired unit also at the McIntosh plant are both operating normally, she said.
The plant has a total generating capacity of about 562 megawatts.
